# proxmox_realm (Resource)

Manages an external Proxmox VE 9 LDAP, Active Directory, or OpenID Connect authentication realm through `/access/domains`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_realm" "sso" {
  realm      = "corp-sso"
  type       = "openid"
  issuer_url = "https://id.example.com"
  client_id  = "proxmox"

  client_key         = var.proxmox_oidc_client_key
  client_key_version = 1

  username_claim = "email"
  scopes         = "openid email profile"
  audiences      = "proxmox"
  autocreate     = true
  comment        = "Corporate OpenID Connect realm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Authentication realm identifier. The built-in `pam` and `pve` realms are not supported. Changes require replacement.
- `type` (String) External realm type: `ldap`, `ad`, or `openid`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `acr_values` (String) OpenID Authentication Context Class Reference values.
- `audiences` (String) Additional OpenID audiences accepted alongside `client_id` (Proxmox VE 9).
- `autocreate` (Boolean) Automatically create Proxmox users after a successful OpenID login.
- `base_dn` (String) LDAP base distinguished name. Required for `ldap` and optional for `ad`.
- `bind_dn` (String) LDAP bind distinguished name.
- `bind_password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) LDAP bind password. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and must be paired with `bind_password_version`. The value is never stored in plan or state.
- `bind_password_version` (Number) Version counter for `bind_password`. Increment it to rotate the password; removing it deletes a previously managed remote password.
- `ca_path` (String) Path on the Proxmox cluster to the LDAP CA certificate file or directory.
- `client_id` (String) OpenID Connect client identifier. Required for `openid`.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) OpenID Connect client secret. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and must be paired with `client_key_version`. The provider discards any value returned by Proxmox and never stores it in plan or state.
- `client_key_version` (Number) Version counter for `client_key`. Increment it to rotate the secret; removing it deletes a previously managed remote client key.
- `comment` (String) Realm description shown in the Proxmox login interface.
- `default` (Boolean) Use this realm as the cluster default. Proxmox clears this setting from every other realm when enabled.
- `domain` (String) Active Directory domain name. Required for `ad`.
- `issuer_url` (String) OpenID Connect issuer URL. Required for `openid`.
- `mode` (String) LDAP protocol mode: `ldap`, `ldaps`, or `ldap+starttls`.
- `port` (Number) LDAP or Active Directory server port.
- `prompt` (String) OpenID authorization prompt value.
- `query_userinfo` (Boolean) Query the OpenID userinfo endpoint for claim values.
- `scopes` (String) Space-separated OpenID scopes.
- `server1` (String) Primary LDAP or Active Directory server. Required for `ldap` and `ad`.
- `server2` (String) Fallback LDAP or Active Directory server.
- `user_attr` (String) LDAP attribute containing the username. Required for `ldap` and optional for `ad`.
- `username_claim` (String) OpenID claim used as the username. Proxmox fixes this value at realm creation, so changes require replacement.
- `verify` (Boolean) Verify the LDAP server TLS certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Realm identifier (same as `realm`).
